shots.say: This bug came from Asia, and it wants your house.
It's only about two-thirds of an inch long.
In fall, they can enter houses in large numbers.
Good news, they won't breed inside.
But never vacuum them. The vacuum will stink.
Subscribe. Next: the wasp that walks a cockroach home.
